name: Eastern Towhee
facts: Call pattern: a sharp note followed by a trill, famously written "drink-your-teeeea."
Habitat: dense thickets and forest edges. Rakes through leaf litter with a two-footed backward hop.
Migration: short-distance. Northern birds winter in the southern United States.
